feedback.details: `bunx tsc --noEmit` exits with code 0 and produces no output. The pre-existing 8 errors in tests/ for missing noDocs and documenter properties have been fixed. All tests/ files now include the required properties (confirmed by grep showing noDocs in tests/refinement.test.ts and tests/harness-documenter.test.ts).

The previously-identified unused truncateStaticAnalysisOutput import in cross-feature-integration.test.ts has been removed (grep returns nothing). Biome check reports zero unused import warnings across shared/ and claude-harness/. The only biome findings are 6 noExplicitAny warnings in tracing.ts, which is not an import issue.

Critical failures: (1) Two exported functions in shared/config.ts completely lack JSDoc: `parseCli` (line 112) and `validateConfig` (line 374). (2) While all other exported functions have JSDoc comment blocks with descriptions, NONE of them include @param tags. The contract explicitly requires '@param tags for each parameter'. Every exported function across regression.ts (4 functions), diff.ts (1), static-analysis.ts (2), refinement.ts (6), and config.ts (3 with JSDoc) is missing @param tags. This is a systematic gap affecting 16+ functions.

10 out of 13 required modules are missing corresponding test files in shared/: artifact-digest.test.ts, conversation-logger.test.ts, doc-validation.test.ts, files.test.ts, interaction.test.ts, logger.test.ts, prompts.test.ts, skills.test.ts, tracing.test.ts, and usage.test.ts. Only regression, diff, static-analysis, refinement, and config have test files in shared/. Note: some of these modules have tests in tests/ directory but the contract specifically requires shared/<name>.test.ts files.

`bun test shared/` produces 124 pass, 0 fail, 277 expect() calls across 10 files. This meets the >= 124 test count requirement. Exit code 0. All tests from sprints 1-5 continue to pass. Full project tests (`bun test tests/`) also pass: 391 pass, 0 fail.

`bunx biome check shared/ claude-harness/` exits with code 0 (success). It reports 6 warnings, all for noExplicitAny in shared/tracing.ts, which is configured as 'warn' in biome.json (not an error). No errors found. Some biome-ignore comments were modified in sprint 6 (changed from lint/style/noVar to lint/correctness/noInnerDeclarations in tracing.ts) but these are updates to existing suppressions, not new ones.

Grep for 'as any', ': any', and '<any>' across all specified Phase 1 files (shared/regression.ts, shared/diff.ts, shared/static-analysis.ts, shared/refinement.ts, shared/artifact-digest.ts, and their test files) returns no matches. The `any` usages flagged by biome are in shared/tracing.ts which is not a Phase 1 Deepen file.

Biome reports no unused variables or unreachable code. The consecutive comment blocks found (3+ lines in cross-feature-integration.test.ts) are section header comments like '// === 1. Sprint selection + regression injection ===' used for organizing test sections, not commented-out code. Similar blocks in tracing.ts and prompts.ts are documentation comments. No actual dead code found.

All 4 JSON.parse call sites in shared/ are properly guarded: regression.ts:28 has try-catch returning [] with descriptive warning; files.ts:132 (readContract) has try-catch throwing descriptive error with file path; files.ts:152 (readFeedback) has try-catch with descriptive error; files.ts:165 (readProgress) has try-catch with descriptive error including path. No bare JSON.parse calls exist.

All 124 tests from sprint 5 continue to pass. The cross-feature-integration.test.ts tests covering combined flags, regression+refinement, sprint selection+lint-gate, etc. all pass. TypeScript compilation is clean. The malformed regression.json handling is verified by test output showing proper warning messages.

overallSummary: Sprint 6 fails due to two critical gaps. First, JSDoc comments are missing @param tags on all 16+ exported functions (and 2 functions in config.ts lack JSDoc entirely), scoring only 4/10 against a threshold of 7. Second, 10 out of 13 required shared/ modules are missing their corresponding .test.ts files in the shared/ directory, scoring only 2/10. The cleanup work (TypeScript errors, unused imports, error handling, any casts) was done well, but the JSDoc and test coverage requirements were not met.
